skills: Up to 4 shots: three Physical, the 4th Electric.

Hold: Sniper Stance, firing continuously for Electric DMG; steer left, right or back. She auto-evades one attack (once per 8s); evading or moving just before a hit is a Perfect Dodge with a charged counter. Firing and counters give 25 Purge (max 100). Release for a Finishing Move that triggers the previous Agent's Quick Assist (once per 25s).
With Purge, when another Agent lands a Basic, Dodge Counter, Special, Dash Attack or Quick Assist: she circles in and fires two Electric shots (3 Purge). Aftershock; once per 3s for the squad.
With Purge, when another Agent lands an EX, Assist Follow-Up or Ultimate heavy hit: three shots and a finisher for Electric DMG (5 Purge). Aftershock; each skill type can trigger it twice per 20s.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Slashes then a charged shot for Electric DMG.

Slash and leaping shot for massive Electric DMG; triggers the previous Agent's Quick Assist. Enters Coordinated Support for 8s: any squadmate hit fires a free Harmonizing Shot with no cooldown (up to 4; stacks to 20s and 10 shots).
Continuous shots for massive Electric DMG.
Wide powerful shot for massive Electric DMG; triggers the previous Agent's Quick Assist and Coordinated Support for 12s (up to 6 shots).

core.name: Soul-Searching Gaze
core.text: Her Aftershock hits raise the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by {0}% for 5s, even before it's Stunned.

ability.name: Silver Lantern's Gaze
ability.text: Each 1% CRIT Rate above 40% gives her Aftershocks +1.5% Daze (max 75%).

mindscapes: Core Passive Stun DMG Multiplier +20%. Harmonizing Shot cooldown 2s. Sniper Stance gives 25% more Purge, max 125.
Each Aftershock gives 1 Hunter's Gaze, and the Sniper Stance finisher gives 2: +6% squad CRIT DMG each (max 4, 10s).
Entering or extending Coordinated Support makes the next Harmonizing Shot trigger Disconnect: +200% ATK as DMG and Daze equal to 120% of her Impact, with high Interrupt Level.
Enters battle with 5 Armor Break Rounds, +1 per 25 Purge spent (max 5). Sniper Stance hits spend one for 1,200% ATK as Electric DMG, +50% more (once per 0.2s).
